name: SCRIPTED_ITEM_SPEECH_V1
owner_decision: SRV7 scripted item feedback needs explicit MonsterSay opt-in independent of optional ambient audio.
offer_gate: With CHAT_V1 selected, permits server-owned scripted item MonsterSay lines on existing domain 12. Does not enable ambient voices, which still require 288. Legacy CHAT_V1 clients without 386 or 288 receive ordinary Say fallback. No new command, state domain or outer message; mode 4 remains invalid in player intents.
